name: quote_is_never_an_invoice
note: the house rule 'a vendor proposal or quote is never an invoice'. amount is deliberately NOT asserted here: the contract calls that field 'the total due', and a quotation states a quoted total with nothing due, so both an amount and a null are defensible readings and an ambiguous check makes a bad case. doc_type is the rule under test.
